sample_tweets.text: Don’t be lazy and naive. Read the expert report prepared by Dr Shuey. Here’s a link:  caainc.org.au/wp-content/upl…  If you can’t be bothered and want to wait for the Age to report this after the family wins its defamation case here are the key factors that point to the car hitting Ryan full-on, drawn from the Shuey report, ambulance records, police photos, and the response timeline and other research: •  Ambulance report: Paramedics recorded the SUV “struck” Ryan while travelling forty to sixty kilometres an hour. He went onto the bonnet, then the windscreen, which cracked, then was thrown onto the roadway. That directly contradicts the T-bone claim. •  Car damage: Police photos show the windscreen smashed and heavily depressed on the driver’s side, plus damage to the front corner bodywork ahead of the front tyre. A side impact from a bike would not produce that pattern. •  Trajectory and physics: The cyclist was flipped onto the bonnet, over the roof line, then sideways onto the road. Low-speed impacts push people forward; this motion only fits a vehicle still moving at speed. •  Stopping distance: The SUV came to rest nineteen point two metres after impact. Shuey calculated that indicates an impact speed of roughly forty to fifty kilometres an hour, not a stationary turn. •  Point of impact: Twenty-seven metres into Ridley Street, about one point five metres onto the bitumen from the bike path, on a road only three point eight metres wide. The SUV was still partly on the wrong side of the road. •  No braking: Neither the vehicle nor the cyclist braked. A witness reported tyre squeal before impact, consistent with the car cutting the corner at speed. •  Delayed triple-zero call: Crash estimated at one-oh-six pm. Andrews did not call until one-ten pm — roughly six and a half minutes. A nearby resident had already alerted ambulance at one-oh-eight. •  Phone activity instead of help: Records and reports indicate calls to staff, including chief of staff Brett Curran, and arranging a replacement windscreen through Chris Riley and government insurers while Ryan was still on the road.  Due to legal reason the govt insurer refused to replace the windscreen immediately but Andrews staff arranged for Windscreen O’Brien to replace the windscreen with 24 hours.  •  Chief of staff: Brett Curran was Andrews’ chief of staff at the time and is now a Victoria Police assistant commissioner. He has declined to say whether he received a call from the scene. •  Police response: The closest experienced crew, Scott Hanley from Rosebud, was en route with lights and sirens when a more junior Rye crew “jumped the call.” That officer took another six and a half minutes to leave the station. •  Attending officers: Senior Constable Shaina Sage and Constable Daniel Ward were the only ones who attended. They later visited Ryan at his mother’s house, phoned Catherine Andrews first, and told him he caused the crash and was lucky not to be charged — without taking a formal statement from him. •  No breath test: Catherine Andrews was never breathalysed, despite standard procedure for a serious crash. •  Vehicle removed: The damaged SUV was driven from the scene before any forensic examination. •  Driver name: Police recorded the driver as “Catherine Louise Kesik” — her maiden name — on the traffic incident report. Shuey called this an irregularity that should have stood out and part of an overt cover-up. •  No proper investigation: No scene measurements, no proper photos at the time, no interview with Ryan, statements from the Andrews taken almost a month later. Shuey described it as deeply flawed and lacking even rudimentary examination. Those are the main ones. The physics and the ambulance report are the strongest on the “car hit him” point; the response and phone activity are the strongest on the aftermath.

🤖 [GEMINI 분석] 2026-09-15 22:15 KST
🟡 위협 점수: 5/10 (보통)

### 1. 현재 주요 사이버보안 트렌드
최근 사이버 공격은 AI를 활용하여 취약점 발견부터 익스플로잇까지의 시간을 8초 이내로 단축하는 등 공격의 자동화 및 고도화가 두드러지고 있습니다([TheHackerNews](https://thehackernews.com/2026/09/human-attacker-exploits-marimo-rce.html)). 특히 소프트웨어 공급망 공격과 클라우드 자격 증명 탈취를 노리는 대규모 스캔 캠페인이 활발하며, AI 에이전트가 악성 패키지 유포에 관여하는 등 새로운 형태의 위협이 관측되고 있습니다([SecurityWeek](https://www.securityweek.com/openai-investigates-report-linking-ai-agents-to-rubygems-attack/)). 또한, 랜섬웨어 조직들이 VMware vCenter와 같은 핵심 인프라의 취약점을 즉각적으로 악용하고 있어 패치 관리의 중요성이 그 어느 때보다 강조됩니다([BleepingComputer](https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/cisa-critical-vmware-vcenter-rce-flaw-now-exploited-by-ransomware-gangs/)).

### 2. 주요 위협 행위자 / 캠페인
- **Sandworm**: Cisco 취약점을 연쇄적으로 활용하여 Cyclops Blink 봇넷을 배포 중([DarkReading](https://www.darkreading.com/cyberattacks-data-breaches/sandworm-chains-cisco-vulnerabilities-cyclops-blink)).
- **Black Axe**: 글로벌 금융 사기 및 로맨스 스캠을 주도하며, 최근 주요 리더들이 미국으로 인도되어 기소됨([BleepingComputer](https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/black-axe-gang-members-extradited-to-us-face-cybercrime-charges/)).
- **Toy Ghouls**: HiveMQ MQTT 브로커 및 Matrix 프로토콜을 C2 서버로 사용하는 새로운 백도어 캠페인 수행([Securelist](https://securelist.com/toy-ghouls-new-hivemq-and-element-backdoors/121270/)).
- **Mirage Kitten**: Node.js 기반의 NodeRabbit, JavaScript 기반의 PollCat 등 신규 악성코드를 사용하여 중동 및 아프리카의 항공/핀테크 분야 타겟팅([Securelist](https://securelist.com/mirage-kitten-new-backdoors-noderabbit-pollcat/121244/)).

### 3. 한국 관련 위협
- **의료기관 대상 랜섬웨어**: 국내 의료기관을 대상으로 RDP 드라이브 리다이렉션 기능을 악용한 Beast(GodDamn) 랜섬웨어 공격 확인([이스트시큐리티 알약](https://blog.alyac.co.kr/5779)).
- **Slack 피싱**: 정상적인 Slack 워크스페이스 초대 기능을 악용하여 국내 기업을 대상으로 피싱 메일 유포 중([이스트시큐리티 알약](https://blog.alyac.co.kr/5780)).
- **공공기관 위협**: NoName057(16) 등 핵티비스트 그룹이 일본뿐만 아니라 한국을 포함한 주변국 정부 및 금융 기관을 지속적으로 타겟팅하고 있음([AhnLab ASEC](https://asec.ahnlab.com/ko/95389/)).

### 4. 주요 CVE / 취약점
- **CVE-2026-85706**: GitLab CE/EE 경로 탐색 취약점, CVSS 10.0(Critical), 즉시 패치 권고([DarkReading](https://www.darkreading.com/cyberattacks-data-breaches/maximum-severity-gitlab-flaw-supply-chains-risk)).
- **VMware vCenter RCE**: 랜섬웨어 조직에 의해 활발히 악용 중, 긴급 업데이트 필요([BleepingComputer](https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/cisa-critical-vmware-vcenter-rce-flaw-now-exploited-by-ransomware-gangs/)).
- **CVE-2026-76356**: Splunk SOAR Automation Broker 내 IP 스푸핑을 통한 인증 우회 취약점([CyStackSecurity](https://twitter.com/CyStackSecurity/status/2099845704092926178)).

### 5. IOC 요약
- **CVE**: CVE-2026-85706 ([DarkReading](https://www.darkreading.com/cyberattacks-data-breaches/maximum-severity-gitlab-flaw-supply-chains-risk), [이스트시큐리티 알약](https://blog.alyac.co.kr/5778))

### 6. 즉각 대응 권고
- **GitLab 패치**: CVE-2026-85706 취약점 대응을 위해 즉시 최신 버전으로 업데이트하고 저장소 커밋 API 접근 제어 강화.
- **RDP 보안 강화**: 국내 의료기관 등 RDP를 사용하는 조직은 드라이브 리다이렉션 기능을 비활성화하고, 다중 인증(MFA)을 필수 적용.
- **Slack 보안 교육**: 임원 사칭 및 정상 기능을 악용한 피싱 메일이 유포 중이므로, 외부 워크스페이스 초대 수락 시 주의하도록 임직원 보안 인식 교육 실시.
